ns2:course.label: Intermediate Financial and Estate Planning
ns2:course.description: Covers financial and estate planning philosophies, techniques, and procedures. Students will utilize case studies and problem-solving activities to construct financial plans for individuals and families in various life cycle stages and family structures. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ACE 240, ECON 302, and junior standing or consent of instructor; FIN 230 or ACE 398 (RM) are recommended.
